news.title: Ajwa Fun World & Resort Limited Appoints Santukumar Pranal Lalani as Additional Director (Non-Executive Independent Director), Effective January 12, 2026
news.body: Ajwa Fun World & Resort Limited, in its Board Meeting held on January 12, 2026, appointed Mr. Santukumar Pranal Lalani as Additional Director (Non-Executive Independent Director) of the Company with effect from January 12, 2026. Mr. Santukumar Pranal Lalani shall hold office as Additional Director of the Company till the ensuing Annual General Meeting of the Company. The appointment was made on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and in accordance with Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. Mr. Santukumar Pranal Lalani possesses vast experience in the entertainment sector. Mr. Santukumar Pranal Lalani does not hold any relation with any of the existing Directors currently on the Board of the Company.
